title: Descent of normalized restriction and scalar association
statement: For exact pullback and scalar restriction on a compatible coefficient square, localize the ordinary restriction square with the specified factorization formula. Exact pullback preserves flat-term K-flat resolving objects and has an ambient tensor isomorphism normalized on two resolving factors. For any normalized scalar presentations on source and target, balanced scalar association descends to an extension isomorphism with exactly the stipulated cochain kappa normalization.

source.place: Tags 07A4, 0G7E and 06YU; scalar-unit refinement with sites-modules.tex Tag 03EL; parent proof steps 1–6.

proof.text: The exact-functor derived square and its factorization formula localize the ordinary restriction square.
Apply the canonical tensor pullback comparison and exact signed comparison for preservation of the resolving class.

On resolving complexes compose the source counit, exact pullback factorization, cochain scalar association and inverse target counit. Naturality gives an isomorphism on the resolving class. Full faithfulness of the resolving localization descends it to all unbounded objects; cancel the counits to obtain its specified formula.

proof_origin.place: Explicit formalization of the parent scalar/unit refinement of Tags 07A4 and 0G7E.
